name: Spanish guitar for a private party: the Sabicas verdiales
description: A short piece by Sabicas on solo Spanish guitar, played live. If you're planning a private party, you can book Dirty Flamenco's guitarist on his own.
more: Celebrity Cruises hired Gary Meyers as its first solo guitarist, and he played flamenco on the Celebrity Solstice across the Mediterranean. When you'd like a bigger sound, he leads Dirty Flamenco as a trio with bass and cajón (a box drum).
